summary: Parts Requests (Operations > Faults > Request a Part) — backend + frontend end-to-end validated. 10/10 backend pytest cases pass (meta, equipment-search, coverage, create, get, attachment upload/download via object storage, AI identify, submit + email + service-desk push, public supplier card + attachment no-auth, full supplier lifecycle acknowledge→quote→invoice→allocate→despatch→complete with all fields persisted, exploded drawings CRUD). Frontend: login → /parts-requests list → New Request → machine search finds ISO-TM-001 → cover-badge-chargeable renders → add-part → submit → back to list → detail page shows supplier-card link + timeline events. Public /parts-card/{token} loads with NO auth, Acknowledge and Send Quote both succeed and status pips update (Acknowledged, Quoted). Faults sub-menu pill data-testid='faults-view-request-part' visible in Operations > Faults (Pro/Full dashboard).

minor.issue: manufacturer/model/title/equipment_type/is_global are declared as plain str/bool defaults so FastAPI treats them as QUERY parameters, not multipart Form fields. If a client uploads them as form-data (natural for multipart) they are silently dropped and the drawing is saved with empty metadata. Fix: annotate them with Form(...) (e.g. `manufacturer: str = Form('')`). Frontend currently must send them as query params.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing data-testid='parts-page' on the list root that the review request references (only new-request-btn / empty-new-request-btn / parts-empty-state exist). Add data-testid='parts-page' to the outer container for test parity.

The added part row's part-name/part-number/qty inputs have no data-testid attributes (add-part-{mi} button exists, but the resulting input fields do not). Playwright fell back to a placeholder search and accidentally typed into the machine-search input; the submitted request ended up with 'No specific parts listed' on the supplier card. Add data-testid='part-name-{mi}-{pi}', 'part-number-{mi}-{pi}', 'part-qty-{mi}-{pi}' to make the form robust.

Review references data-testid^='timeline-event-*' — only 2 events were found for a submitted request (created + submitted). After running the full supplier lifecycle on the same request, operator detail is expected to show ~7 supplier events; not re-verified end-to-end from the UI (verified via backend API only). Please confirm all supplier events render on the operator detail timeline.

action_items: Convert POST /api/exploded-drawings query params (manufacturer/model/title/equipment_type/is_global) to Form(...) so multipart form-data uploads set them correctly.
Add data-testid='parts-page' to the /parts-requests list root container.
Add data-testid attributes to the part-row inputs (part-name-{mi}-{pi}, part-number-{mi}-{pi}, part-qty-{mi}-{pi}) so tests can reliably fill parts.
(Optional) Verify operator detail timeline renders every supplier lifecycle event (acknowledge/quote/invoice/allocate/despatch/complete).
critical_code_review_comments: parts_requests.py is 697 lines — approaching the split threshold; consider splitting into parts_requests_meta/attachments/supplier_card modules for maintainability.
upload_drawing signature uses bare str/bool params: FastAPI silently binds them to query string on multipart requests. Use `Form(...)` or a Pydantic model + explicit File field.

supplier_card_update() is untenanted (token-only) — good for public card; make sure token is UUID-random (it is via uuid4) and consider rate-limiting the update endpoint too (public GET is rate-limited, POST /update is not).
AI identify loads the full file bytes and b64 encodes in the request handler thread; consider streaming or size limits for very large photos (currently bounded by 25MB upload cap so acceptable).
Frontend part-row inputs missing data-testid — impacts test automation and possibly assistive tech labelling.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (list, editor, machine search, cover badge, submit, detail, public card acknowledge+quote, Pro faults pill)
